capabilities: Look up rhymes for a selected, typed or cursor-followed word
Show stress marks and re-rank rhymes when stress is moved
Display definitions, etymology and word forms from Russian Wiktionary
Translate English words to Russian and back offline
disambiguation: More than a rhyme finder; the same panel also gives definitions, etymology, associations and offline English-Russian translations.
extras: The ~78 MB dictionary is a one-time manual download from a GitHub release and can be moved into the vault for Obsidian Sync; some data layers (KartaSlov) are licensed CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Writers in Russian have no built-in way in Obsidian to find rhymes, check stress or look up meanings and synonyms while composing.
summary: Offline Russian reference panel that shows rhymes, stress marks, definitions, synonyms and English-Russian translations for the selected or typed word.
